#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int find_set(int x, vector<int>& parent) {
    int root = x;
    while (root != parent[root]) root = parent[root];
    while (x != root) {
        int nxt = parent[x];
        parent[x] = root;
        x = nxt;
    }
    return root;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        long long ans = 1;
        for (long long i = 1; i < p; ++i) ans = ans * p % MOD;
        cout << ans;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> parent((size_t)p);
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) parent[i] = i;

    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        long long to = (k * i) % p;
        int a = find_set(i, parent);
        int b = find_set((int)to, parent);
        parent[a] = b;
    }

    vector<int> cnt((size_t)p, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        cnt[find_set(i, parent)]++;
    }

    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (cnt[i]) ans = ans * p % MOD;
    }
    if (k == 1) ans = ans * p % MOD;

    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}
